title: oxytropis campestris subsp. tatrae
intro: Oxytropis campestris subsp. tatrae, commonly known as Tatra alpine milkvetch, is a perennial plant species belonging to the pea family Fabaceae. This plant has been found to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Oxytropis campestris subsp. tatrae include its potential use in treating conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal disorders, although further research is needed to confirm its efficacy. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
